title: Chartered Accountant
description:
Designation: Chartered Accountant (CA)

Experience Required: 7+ Years

Location: Kochi Infopark

Working Days: Monday to Friday and alternate Saturdays

Working Hours: US PST (8:30 PM to 5:30 AM – Night Shift)

Company Name & Location

US Office:

Syriac CPA Tax & Accounting Services Inc.

10900 183rd St, Suite 171-C, Cerritos, CA 90703, United States

India Office:

Syriac Consultancy Services Pvt. Ltd.

Ground Floor, Thapasya Building, Office No. GB-2, Infopark Phase 1, Kakkanad, Kerala – 682042

Website:
www.syriaccpa.com

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced and qualified Chartered Accountant with a minimum of 7 years of accounting experience and strong expertise in end-to-end accounting operations. The ideal candidate should have comprehensive knowledge of the entire accounting cycle, from recording financial transactions and maintaining ledgers to preparing financial statements, managing month-end and year-end closures, and ensuring financial accuracy and compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Oversee day-to-day accounting operations and ensure accurate recording and classification of financial transactions.

Prepare, review, and finalize financial statements, including the profit and loss statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement.

Perform monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing activities, ensuring timely and accurate completion.

Manage accounts payable and receivable processes, including invoice verification, payment tracking, collections, and outstanding balance monitoring.

Analyze financial data, identify variances, and provide insights to support financial decision-making.

Coordinate with internal teams and relevant stakeholders to resolve accounting queries and maintain smooth financial operations.

Maintain accurate financial documentation and ensure records are organized and audit-ready.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification is mandatory.

Minimum 7 years of relevant accounting experience.

Strong expertise in end-to-end accounting and the complete accounting cycle.

Thorough understanding of journal entries, general ledger, reconciliations, financial statements, and closing procedures.

Strong knowledge of accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, accruals, prepayments, and balance sheet reconciliations.

Experience with QuickBooks Online (QBO) or QuickBooks Desktop (QBD) is highly preferred.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and financial reporting skills.

Excellent attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills.

Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines with minimal supervision.

Good verbal and written communication skills.

High levels of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.

Willingness to work the US night shift from the Kochi Infopark office.

title: SAP FICA Functional-SENIOR

**SAP FI-CA**
to join the EYD GDS team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth.

* To provide functional knowledge with hands-on experience in electricity, gas and water utilities.
* Hands on experience configuring the IS-U system
* Drive Business Workshops, Blueprint Sessions, develop BBPs/BBDs FS, Test Scenarios, conduct Trainings, perform Testing and provide defect management support for Device Management module
* Design core / customized business processes and provide best practices for ISU.
* Communicate complex requirements to and from Technical and Non-technical stakeholders

* Monitors the progress and the quality of the project

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Should understand different business processes in the Utility Industry (Regulated and Deregulated)
* Should possess SAP FICA knowledge for preparation of business blueprints, business process plan (BPP), functional documents, and test cases etc.
* Should have knowledge of the Meter to Cash
* Should have experience in FICA Dunning procedure/Collection Strategy, payment (cash desk/external cash desk) integration with payment channels, write off, return processing, security deposit, installment plan, and promise to pay.
* Exposure of Country specific localization.
* Experience in BRIM CI FICA is good to have.
* Experience in configuring FICA Events and BRF+ (functional).
* Strong knowledge of clearing strategy, clearing rules.
* Experience in Cash Desk and clarifications.
* Strong knowledge of month-end and period-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Experience in the de-regulated/Regulated energy market.
* Develop templates and methods to improve the efficiency of application support.
* Gather and prioritize relevant SAP Business requirements and designing the appropriate solution
* Understands configuration dependencies and inter-relationships between other modules of SAP such as Device Management, CS/CRM, Billing and design and troubleshoot in the area with this knowledge
* Define test scenarios to cover full scope of the business as well as creating master data and carry out the unit, cycle and integration tests
* Should be well versed to make enhancements in specific FICA events.
* Must have completed multiple SAP projects and have excellent communication skills
* Confidence working within an offshore/onshore delivery model
* Proven expedience large stream of work across multiple locations
* Consulting experience advantageous
* Strong hands-on experience on FI-CA concepts:

+ Company Code Setup
+ Chart of Accounts and GL setup
+ Main / Sub Transaction Setup
+ Security Deposit Process
+ Incoming Payments (Real Time, Direct Debit, Cash Desk, etc.)
+ Outgoing Payments and Returns
+ Collection process using Collection Strategy
+ Collection Agency related process
+ Transfer Posting process
+ Escheatment process

* Strong knowledge of month-end and period-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Implementation experience of BRF Plus.
* Experience and knowledge of using middleware technology to integrate SAP with third party systems for payments, collection agencies, etc.
* Experience in data migration.
* Can work under minimum supervision, good time management and work planning

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 5 to 8 years of experience in a functional role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* Prior SAP BRIM CI role is a must
* Should have worked on minimum 1 implementation from scratch as a lead consultant.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience on integration with third-party applications
* Knowledge of integration with SAP RAR, BRIM CI/SOM/CM
* Hands on experience in SAP S4 HANA Platform
* Experience on tools like JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.
* SAP Utilities certifications are a plus:

+ Certification in SAP FICA (IUT240 / AC240 / BR240)
+ Certifications in SAP BRIM Convergent Invoicing (AC245 / BR245)

**Technologies and Tools**

* SAP FI-CA / FI-CAX
* SAP FIORI
* Jira or similar tools
* Azure DevOps or similar tools

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Utilities practices globally with leading businesses across a range of geographies

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Junior Accountant
description:
**Company Description**

SalesOne specializes in helping B2B companies scale their revenue through expert outbound sales support without requiring a full internal sales team. We provide startups and growth-stage businesses with a comprehensive range of services, including lead research, list building, email outreach, and appointment setting. Our data-driven approach ensures predictable pipeline growth, and our combination of strategy and execution empowers founders to focus on closing deals. SalesOne collaborates with B2B leaders across various industries to optimize outbound performance, enhance sales operations, and accelerate go-to-market success.

**Role Description:**

We are seeking a meticulous and detail-oriented Junior Accountant to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will play a vital role in managing financial records, preparing reports, and ensuring compliance with accounting standards. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, oversee financial transactions, and actively contribute to maintaining the accuracy and integrity of the company’s financial operations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Managing day-to-day transactions through banks and maintaining payments.
* Managing and recording bills and expenses.
* Managing vendor payments, ensuring timely clearance of pending payments.
* Assisting in preparing and filing GST returns, ensuring timely payments and maintaining records.
* Calculating and deducting TDS, preparing and filing TDS returns.
* Processing salaries, maintaining payrolls, and handling ESIC, EPF, and Professional Tax.
* Preparing customer invoices, following up on outstanding payments, and maintaining records of receivables.
* Preparing and maintaining monthly and yearly financial reports, including balance sheets, profit and loss statements, and cash flow statements.
* Assisting in income tax return preparation and filing.
* Creating monthly and yearly budgets, tracking expenses against the budget, and providing financial forecasts.
* Monitoring cash inflows and outflows to ensure liquidity.
* Maintaining records of company assets and performing monthly Audits.
* Managing Recurring Payments.
* Maintaining monthly bank reconciliations.
* Managing accounting software and posting transactions to journals, ledgers, and other records.
* Evaluating daily balances.
* Preparing payment vouchers and maintaining detailed expense reports.
* Supporting month-end and year-end close processes.
* Maintaining Financial and non Financial Documents.
* Conducting financial analysis and providing insights for decision-making.
* Collaborating with other departments to ensure financial data and reporting accuracy.
* Ensuring compliance with statutory regulations and guidelines.
* Staying updated with industry trends and best practices in accounting.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce (B.Com/M.Com) or related field.
* 0–2 years of experience in accounting, finance, or internship roles.
* Basic knowledge of accounting principles, GST, TDS, and financial regulations.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and familiarity with accounting software (Zoho Books) preferred.
* Strong numerical accuracy, documentation, and organizational skills.
* Good communication skills and the ability to coordinate with internal and external stakeholders.

**Perks:**

* Job Offer: Three-month probation period with the possibility of transitioning into a full-time role upon successful completion.
* Equipment: A dedicated Apple Silicon MacBook will be provided for the duration of the
* internship.
* Work-Life Balance: Experience a 5-day workweek

title: Project Management Officer
description:
Project Management Officer (PMO) – Kochi

**Company:**
Dunbar & Boardman

**Location:**
Kochi, Kerala, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time | Hybrid

**Experience:**
Open to junior and mid-level professionals

Company Description

Established in the United Kingdom in 1981,
**Dunbar & Boardman (D&B)**
is an independent specialist engineering consultancy providing Vertical Transportation (VT) and Façade Access (FA) advisory services.

With operations across the UK, Middle East and India, D&B supports leading developers, architects, engineering consultants and asset owners on projects ranging from feasibility and design to construction administration, inspections, modernisation and asset management. Our multidisciplinary teams work on diverse international projects, combining technical expertise, structured project delivery and digital innovation.

Role Description

We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Project Management Officer (PMO) to join our Kochi office and support the effective coordination, monitoring, and administration of projects across D&B's regional operations. The role involves working closely with Project Managers, Senior Project Managers, Portfolio Leads and Discipline Heads to ensure efficient project execution, resource coordination, documentation, reporting and compliance with project schedules and contractual requirements. Candidates with varying levels of experience will be considered, with responsibilities aligned to their demonstrated capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

* **Project Coordination:**
  Support Project Managers and Portfolio Leads in planning, scheduling, tracking and coordinating multiple projects.
* **Portfolio Monitoring:**
  Maintain project trackers, monitor milestones, deliverables, deadlines and project progress across assigned portfolios.
* **Resource Planning:**
  Assist with resource allocation, workload monitoring, capacity planning and utilisation reporting.
* **Timesheet Monitoring:**
  Track timesheet submissions, chargeable and non-chargeable hours, and support accurate project reporting.
* **Project Documentation:**
  Maintain project registers, correspondence, submission records, deliverable trackers and structured project files.
* **Management Reporting:**
  Prepare project dashboards, progress reports, KPI summaries and management updates.
* **Commercial Coordination:**
  Assist with monitoring project budgets, variations, additional services, invoicing milestones and outstanding project-related actions.
* **Quality & Compliance:**
  Support adherence to internal procedures, document control standards, project workflows and quality management requirements.
* **Stakeholder Coordination:**
  Facilitate effective communication between project teams, clients and external stakeholders.
* **Digital Improvement:**
  Support the implementation of project management systems, reporting automation, AI-enabled workflows and process improvement initiatives.

Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business Administration, Commerce or a related discipline.
* Strong organisational, analytical, communication and coordination skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, monitor deadlines and maintain accurate project records.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Familiarity with project management tools such as MS Project, Primavera P6, SharePoint, Power BI or similar platforms is an advantage.
* Experience in project coordination, PMO, project administration, document control or project operations is desirable.
* Experience in engineering consultancy, construction, architecture, building services or infrastructure projects will be an added advantage.
* Understanding of resource planning, project KPIs, utilisation reporting and project financial monitoring is beneficial.
* Interest in digital transformation, automation and AI-enabled project management tools is encouraged.

Who Can Apply?

We welcome applications from:

* **Junior Professionals:**
  Graduates and early-career candidates with strong coordination, analytical and digital skills.
* **Mid-Level Professionals:**
  Candidates with practical experience in project coordination, PMO operations, scheduling and reporting.

The designation and responsibilities will be aligned with the candidate's experience and capabilities.

Why Join D&B?

* Opportunity to work with international engineering teams across the UK, Middle East and India.
* Exposure to diverse and technically challenging projects.
* Structured professional development and opportunities for career progression.
* Involvement in digital project delivery, automation and continuous improvement.
* Collaborative working environment within an established specialist engineering consultancy.

As part of the Quantitative Trading Book (QTB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk, treasury, and front to back-office functions. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk and valuation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision making for clients with capital markets activities. * Strong understanding of statistical and numerical techniques (e.g., Monte Carlo, finite difference methods)
* Knowledge of derivative pricing concepts across asset classes (rates, equities, credit, FX, commodities)

* Understanding of optimization techniques (e.g., gradient‑based methods) relevant to calibration, risk analytics, and numerical model implementation.
* Experience in model development, validation, monitoring, and audit procedures (stress testing, back testing, benchmarking) of trading book models.
* Strong coding skills in advanced Python / C++ and basic SQL
* Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in risk management, model validation, and quantitative workflow automation.
* Excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem solving skills.

* Exposure to market risk and counterparty credit risk methodologies (VaR, ES, SVaR, CVA, PFE) and time series techniques (e.g. GARCH).
* Hands on experience with pricing model development/validation (e.g., HW1F/2F, HJM, LMM, SABR, Heston, Dupire), volatility calibration, curve bootstrapping.
* Experience with risk/pricing systems such as Murex, Calypso, Numerix, Bloomberg, Calypso, SunGard Adaptiv, RiskMetrics, etc.

**What We Look For**

* Undergraduate or graduate degree in quantitative disciplines (Comp. Finance, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, Physics) or PhD in quantitative topics
* Regulatory knowledge in FRTB Basel, CCAR
* Professional certifications (CQF, FRM, PRM, RAI are a plus)
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and support engagements with global financial institutions

title: Lock Desk Analyst – U.S. Mortgage
description:
**The Lock Desk Analyst manages mortgage rate lock requests, pricing, lock changes, extensions, relocks, and cancellations according to company policies, investor guidelines, and market pricing. The role involves coordinating with Loan Officers (LOs), Loan Processors (LPs), Secondary Marketing, underwriting, and investors to ensure accurate pricing, timely lock execution, and compliance with established procedures. The analyst also reviews daily investor rate sheets, maintains pricing accuracy in mortgage systems, investigates and resolves pricing discrepancies, and supports the smooth functioning of the mortgage lock desk.**

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Mortgage Rate Lock Management: 

 

Process rate lock requests from Loan Officers (LOs) and Loan Processors (LPs), verify loan details (amount, program, interest rate, LTV, FICO, occupancy, property type, and lock period), ensure eligibility and compliance with company policies and investor guidelines, and accurately process new locks, changes, extensions, relocks, and cancellations on time. Monitor lock expirations, communicate confirmations, rejections, and required corrections, and maintain accurate records in the loan origination system.

 

2. Mortgage Pricing and Rate Sheet Management: 

 

Download and review daily investor rate sheets for dates, pricing adjustments, product availability, and lock periods. Upload and maintain rate sheets and pricing data in the pricing engine. Compare investor pricing with internal systems to identify differences. Review base pricing, loan-level price adjustments (LLPAs), margins, concessions, discount points, and lender credits. Calculate and verify final borrower or broker pricing according to company policies. Provide accurate pricing information to Loan Officers for eligible loan scenarios.

 

3. Lock Extensions, Relocks, and Pricing Exceptions: 

 

Review and process lock extensions, relocks, and pricing exceptions according to company policies. Calculate extension fees, relock fees, and pricing adjustments. Check lock history, expiration dates, previous extensions, and available free extension days. Process pricing concessions and exceptions only after obtaining the required approvals. Verify approval authority and maintain supporting documents. Communicate applicable fees, pricing impacts, and processing restrictions to the requesting teams.

 

4. Investor Guidelines and Product Eligibility: 

 

Review investor guidelines and product eligibility before processing lock requests. Verify delegated and non-delegated lending channels, where applicable. Confirm product availability based on loan program, credit score, occupancy, LTV, loan purpose, and other applicable criteria. Identify investor-specific restrictions and escalate exceptions when needed. Coordinate with investor representatives to resolve pricing, eligibility, and lock-related issues. Ensure all pricing and lock activities follow investor requirements and internal policies. 

5. Communication and Issue Resolution: 

 

Respond to inquiries from Loan Officers, Loan Processors, Secondary Marketing, and other internal teams. Explain pricing differences, lock rejections, extension fees, and investor restrictions clearly. Follow up on pending lock requests, pricing exceptions, and unresolved system issues. Escalate complex pricing and eligibility concerns to the appropriate manager or authorized approver. Maintain professional communication and meet established service-level agreements (SLAs).

 

6. Quality Control and Reporting: 

 

Maintain accurate records of lock requests, confirmations, extensions, relocks, cancellations, and pricing exceptions. Check loan details and pricing for accuracy. Prepare daily or periodic reports on lock activity, expiring locks, pending requests, and pricing issues. Follow internal controls, audit requirements, and documentation standards.

 

**Required Qualifications**

* A Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
* At least 1 year of experience in U.S. mortgage operations, Secondary Marketing, or mortgage rate lock desk operations is preferred.
* Knowledge of mortgage pricing, rate locks, extensions, relocks, cancellations, and Conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, and applicable Non-QM products is required, along with Excel, Microsoft Office, and pricing analysis skills.
* Strong analytical, numerical, problem-solving, and communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple requests under tight deadlines are essential.

 

**Key Competencies & Performance Metrics**

* Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.
* Accuracy in mortgage pricing, rate locks, extensions, and relocks.
* Good time management, prioritization, and attention to detail.
* Effective communication, teamwork, and knowledge of investor guidelines and compliance requirements.
* Timely processing of lock requests, quick resolution of pricing issues, and adherence to company policies and service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Accurate documentation, audit readiness, and reduction of processing errors.

**Work Schedule & Location**

**Must be available to work according to U.S. mortgage business hours, including the applicable U.S. time zone and market-related deadlines.**

Shift Time: 7:30pm to 4:30am IST

title: Independent Director
description:
**What this Board needs protected**

The institution's licence to grow rests on the quality of its lending, funding, customer treatment and control environment. The independent director will sit across the Audit, Risk, NRC and CSR agenda, bringing the ability to see how a commercial decision migrates through credit behaviour, liquidity, collections, provisioning, reputation and regulatory accountability.

This is not a role for a specialist who views risk only through policy limits. The Board requires an individual who can interrogate portfolio movement at cohort and segment level, recognise when apparent stability is being produced by restructures or collection practices, and judge whether capital and liquidity remain adequate under a plausible operating shock. The director must also understand that conduct failures can begin in target design, vendor incentives or digital journeys long before they become complaints.

**The mandate in practice**

The appointee will challenge credit strategy using vintage curves, roll rates, concentration, collection efficiency, loss emergence and collateral realisation rather than a single gross-NPA number. Product approval papers should show the customer need, risk appetite consumed, operational readiness, model limitations, adverse-case economics and accountable owner after launch.

Funding and asset-liability oversight will require close attention to tenor mismatches, refinancing dependence, encumbrance, covenant headroom and liquidity under name-specific stress. The director should insist that contingency actions are executable within the time shown in the stress test—not merely available in theory.

On Audit Committee matters, the member will examine expected-credit-loss governance, management overlays, write-offs, income recognition, related parties, securitisation or assignment accounting, technology access and third-party assurance. On the Risk Committee, the same person must connect those accounting judgements to appetite, collections, fraud, cyber events and operational resilience.

Customer outcomes form a separate line of responsibility. The Board should see complaints by root cause, repeat incidence, vulnerability, channel, product and resolution quality. Outsourced sales, field collection, recovery agents, digital consent and grievance handling must be governed as extensions of the institution, not as vendor matters.

**Questions candidates should be ready to answer**

* When can rapid portfolio growth make the headline delinquency ratio temporarily more reassuring rather than more informative?
* What evidence would cause you to challenge a management overlay even when the external auditor accepts it?
* How do you test whether a liquidity contingency plan can be executed during simultaneous market and reputation stress?
* Which early conduct indicators belong at Board level before a regulator or ombudsman trend is visible?
* How would you distinguish healthy digital underwriting from a model whose exclusions are producing unfair or unstable outcomes?

**Appointment standard**

Candidates may come from regulated lending, banking, insurance, credit bureau, risk, finance or supervisory backgrounds. They should have held enterprise accountability for a balance sheet, credit portfolio, treasury, risk framework or regulated operation. The Board values evidence of independent challenge, remedial follow-through and clear communication under regulatory scrutiny. A valid DIN and completion of statutory independent-director databank obligations are required by appointment. Expect quarterly meetings, committee preparation, an annual risk workshop and occasional availability for material regulatory or liquidity events.

title: Project Planner
description:
**Job Title**
Project Planner
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
The Project Planner will be responsible for developing, monitoring, and controlling project schedules for large-scale hotel, resort, and hospitality construction projects. The role will ensure effective planning, progress tracking, resource optimization, and timely project delivery while supporting project leadership with accurate forecasting and reporting.
  
  
**Job Description**
About the Role:
  
  

* Develop, maintain, and monitor integrated project schedules for construction projects from design through handover.
* Prepare detailed project plans, work breakdown structures (WBS), resource-loaded schedules, critical path analyses, and project progress reports using Primavera P6 and/or MS Project.
* Coordinate with project managers, consultants, architects, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure alignment of project milestones and deliverables.
* Track project performance against baseline schedules, identify delays and risks, and recommend recovery plans and mitigation strategies.
* Generate periodic progress reports, dashboards, earned value analysis, and executive presentations to support project decision-making.
* Review contractor schedules, evaluate extension of time (EOT) claims, and monitor compliance with contractual project timelines.
* Support cost and project controls teams through schedule integration, forecasting, and planning-related analyses.

**About You**

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 6 years of relevant experience in project planning and scheduling for commercial construction projects.
* Strong expertise in MS Project, project controls, critical path methodology (CPM), and project scheduling techniques.
* Proven experience in managing complex hospitality development projects from concept/design stage through construction and commissioning.
* Excellent analytical, reporting, stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Knowledge of construction contracts, claims management, risk assessment, and project control best practices.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with multiple stakeholders and project teams.

Why Join Us?
  
  

* Opportunity to work on prestigious hotel, resort, and hospitality developments across diverse locations.
* Exposure to large-scale projects with international standards and best-in-class project management practices.
* Strong focus on professional development, technical training, and career growth opportunities.
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment that values innovation, excellence, and continuous improvement.

**Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Statement**
**We have a vision of the future, where people simply belong.**
We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every individual is respected and valued. We celebrate diversity across all backgrounds and experiences and believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and success. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities for everyone.

title: EY Business Consulting - Supply Chain Domain - Enterprise Asset Management - Senior Consultant
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY Business Consulting – Supply Chain Domain - Enterprise Asset Management - Senior Consultant**
At EY, our objective is to help clients improve the performance and productivity of their Supply Chain & Operations (SC&O). With expertise in leading Enterprise Asset Management frameworks, you will help clients to effectively manage both the physical and non-physical assets through the entire lifecycle, maximising performance and productivity whilst reducing the total cost of operations / ownership.
  
  
The client base spans across industries and includes multinational companies in oil & gas, power & utilities, government, banking, consumer goods & retail, manufacturing etc.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a passionate Senior Consultant with expertise in
**Enterprise Asset Management (EAM)**
to join the group within our
**Business Consulting**
sub-service line and work with clients and project teams in EAM engagements. The role focuses on asset centric transformation covering governance, lifecycle strategy, performance optimization, and digital enablement—helping clients maximize asset value, optimize TOTEX, improve reliability, and strengthen decision-making across the asset lifecycle.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Consultant, you will be part of a team of professionals with extensive consulting and industry experience. Drawing on your knowledge and experience, you will create innovative insights for clients, bringing software / digital solutions and strategies to optimise their asset management capabilities and sustain performance improvement. As an influential member of the team, you will help create a positive learning culture; coach, counsel, and nurture junior team members.
  
  
An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain, and strengthen internal and external relationships. Travel may be required based on business/client requirement.
  
  
Typically, you will work across below EAM service offerings:
  
  
**Governance and Assurance**

* Design Asset Governance frameworks and Target Operating Models aligned to business strategy and regulatory requirements
* Conduct ISO 55001 alignment assessments and EAM maturity diagnostics
* Develop risk, control, and performance assurance frameworks across asset lifecycle processes
* Integrate ESG considerations into asset strategies, governance models, and performance reporting

**Lifecycle Strategy & TOTEX Optimization**

* Develop Strategic Asset Management Plans (SAMPs) and asset class level AM plans
* Design and document EAM processes, policies, and procedures across the end to end asset lifecycle
* Support asset investment planning, prioritization, and portfolio optimization
* Define value frameworks and TOTEX optimization approaches linking Capex, Opex, risk, and performance
* Support asset decommissioning strategies and transition planning

**Asset Performance & Reliability**

* Deliver asset performance optimization and reliability improvement initiatives
* Design and improve maintenance management and reliability engineering frameworks
* Support work management transformation, including planning, scheduling, and execution optimization
* Optimize asset spares and inventory strategies to balance availability, cost, and risk

**Asset Intelligence & Decision Enablement**

* Define asset data and information management strategies, including data governance and quality
* Develop decision support frameworks and AI readiness roadmaps for EAM and asset￼intensive operations
* Support selection, assessment, and optimization of EAM systems (e.g., SAP EAM, IBM Maximo, Infor, Oracle)
* Drive IoT and sensorization use cases for condition monitoring and predictive insights
* Support implementation of digital twins and BIM enabled asset management solutions

Your consulting and delivery responsibilities will be including and not limited to below:
  
  

* Work closely with MENA clients to translate business and asset management challenges into practical, scalable EAM solutions
* Lead and contribute to client workshops, diagnostics, and design sessions
* Deliver high‑quality consulting outputs aligned to EY quality and delivery standards
* Support business development and proposal efforts aligned to established EAM offerings
* Coach junior team members and contribute to capability building within the EAM practice

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong EAM domain knowledge across governance, lifecycle management, maintenance, and performance
* Experience working across asset intensive industries (Oil & Gas, Utilities, Transport, Infrastructure, Manufacturing, Cities and Municipalities, Facility Management, etc.)
* Understanding of ISO 55001, ESG, and risk based asset management concepts
* Exposure to AI, analytics, IoT, digital twins, and emerging asset technologies
* Structured problem solving, client facing communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to translate strategy into operable processes, frameworks, and systems

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 4–8 years of experience in Enterprise Asset Management, Asset intensive Operations, or related consulting roles
* Consulting experience in asset performance improvement, governance, cost optimization, or process design
* Exposure to EAM systems (SAP EAM, IBM Maximo, Infor, Oracle, Asset investment planning tool, etc.)
* Experience developing process documentation, frameworks, and maturity assessments
* Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain Management
* Willingness to travel onsite for client assignments, if required
* Willingness to work Sunday to Thursday and support MENA region’s client timings

**Ideally, you should also have**

* Project management skills
* Customer handling, Report writing, Strong interpersonal communication skills, and experience in usage of analytical tools/ representations
* Certification / working knowledge in ISO 55001, ISO 14001, and ISO 9001
* Certification in Lean, Six Sigma, TQM, KAIZEN, CAMA 2, IAM Diploma and IAM certificate as an added/preferred advantage

**What We Offer**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of business consultant professionals, in the integrated global business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Business Consulting practices regionally/globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

title: Revenue Operations Reporting Specialist
description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a Reporting Specialist to own the build and ongoing maintenance of our GTM reporting. This is a focused, execution\-oriented role: the Specialist produces and maintains reports and dashboards in Salesforce (SFDC) and other sources to defined specifications, keeps the existing reporting library accurate and current, and works from a structured request queue.
   

  

 The role is designed to be delivered by an offshore resource working in close, documented coordination with our onshore Revenue Operations team. The Salesforce Reporting Specialist does the hands\-on building, refreshing, and quality\-checking of the reports.
   

  

 This is a full\-time role with overall accountability to the Sr. Director, Revenue Operations \& Analytics.
   

  

***Preferred Location and Expected Work Hours***
 This role is based in Kochi, India. Given the need for real\-time collaboration with Dodge's US\-based GTM team, candidates should be comfortable working hours that overlap with US time zones, generally 12:00\-8:00 PM IST.
   

  

***Travel Requirements***
 Expected travel is less than 5% of the time but may occasionally be required for team meetings.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Build new Salesforce reports, custom report types, and dashboards to written specifications provided by the onshore Revenue Operations team
* Maintain, update, and troubleshoot the existing library of Salesforce reports and dashboards, keeping filters, groupings, and data sources accurate and current
* Build and refresh Business Intelligence dashboards and their underlying data extracts to defined specifications
* Perform routine quality assurance on reports and dashboards—verifying accuracy, checking for broken filters or stale data, and confirming figures reconcile to source
* Manage the report and dashboard catalog, including folder structure, naming conventions, and sharing and visibility settings
* Execute and monitor scheduled report refreshes and recurring distributions, confirming successful delivery
* Document report logic, field definitions, and change history so that reporting is transparent and reproducible
* Work a structured request/ticket queue, delivering standard reporting changes within agreed service\-level timeframes
* Log and escalate data discrepancies and suspected upstream data issues to the onshore team for root\-cause resolution
* Regression\-test reports and dashboards following Salesforce releases, additional Dodge hiring and role changes, or configuration changes, and flag anything that breaks


***Education Requirement***
 Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, or technical field, and/or equivalent work experience.
   

  

**Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* 2\+ years building and maintaining reports and dashboards in Salesforce
* Proficiency with the Salesforce report builder, custom report types, and dashboards
* Experience building or maintaining dashboards in Tableau, QuickSight or other comparable Business Intelligence tool
* Strong Excel skills, including lookups and pivot tables
* Excellent written English and clear, asynchronous communication for documented coordination across time zones
* Highly detail\-oriented, with comfort working from specifications, queues, and service\-level expectations
* Reliable availability to overlap with United States Eastern Time business hours


**Preferred Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM\-201\) or equivalent
* Exposure to Salesforce CPQ reporting
* Familiarity with SQL or other data\-preparation tools
* Prior experience working as part of a distributed or offshore delivery team


**About Dodge Construction Network**
 Dodge Construction Network exists to deliver the comprehensive data and connections the construction industry needs to build thriving communities. Our legacy is deeply rooted in empowering our customers with transformative insights, igniting their journey towards unparalleled business expansion and success. We serve decision\-makers who seek reliable growth and who value relationships built on trust and quality. By combining our proprietary data with cutting\-edge software, we deliver to our customers the essential intelligence needed to excel within their respective landscapes. We propel the construction industry forward by transforming data into tangible guidance, driving unparalleled advancement.
   

  

 Dodge is the catalyst for modern construction.

title: ACCOUNTS ASSISTANT
description:
Accounts Assistant
   

  

 The Accounts Assistant will support the Accounts Manager in the day\-to\-day financial operations of the organization. The incumbent will be responsible for accurate billing, timely collection follow\-ups, GST \& TDS compliance support, and maintaining financial records with high accuracy. The role demands strong ownership of the collection process and proactive communication with clients and internal stakeholders.
   

  

**Requirements**
* Prepare and issue accurate sales invoices in a timely manner.
* Verify billing data against purchase orders, contracts, and delivery records.
* Maintain organized billing records and resolve billing discrepancies promptly.
* Coordinate with sales and operations teams to ensure correct invoicing.
* Take ownership of the collections process — proactively track outstanding receivables.
* Send timely payment reminders and follow up with clients via phone and email.
* Maintain an updated debtor aging report and escalate overdue accounts to the Manager.
* Reconcile received payments with invoices and update records accordingly.
* Coordinate with clients to resolve payment disputes and ensure timely closures.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports on billing, collections, and outstanding balances.
* Build and maintain Excel\-based trackers for invoices, receivables, TDS, and GST.
* Provide accurate financial data to the Manager for review and decision\-making.
* Assist in maintaining books of accounts and day\-to\-day accounting entries.
* Support in bank reconciliation and vendor payment tracking.
* File and organize financial documents, vouchers, and supporting records systematically.
* Assist in audit preparation by providing required documents and data.


 What we Expect from you?
   

  

* B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance) or equivalent qualification.
* Minimum 1–2 years of experience in accounts, billing, or finance roles.
* Prior experience handling GST \& TDS compliance is preferred.
* Hands\-on experience with accounting software will be an added advantage.
* Freshers with strong academics and relevant internship experience may also be considered


 What you've got?
   

  

* Career Growth: Opportunity to build a career in Accounts and Finance.
* Practical Exposure: Hands\-on experience in billing, collections, GST, TDS, bank reconciliation, and accounting operations.
* Learning Opportunities: Exposure to day\-to\-day financial processes and compliance activities.
* Professional Development: Opportunity to improve Excel, accounting software, communication, and reporting skills.
* Industry Experience: Experience working with clients, vendors, sales, operations, and internal teams.
* Responsibility \& Ownership: Opportunity to independently manage billing and collection activities.
* Team Environment: Supportive and professional work environment with guidance from the Accounts Manager.

title: Manager-FDI-FINANCE TECH
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Manager – FDI**
**EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance**
 As a Manager in our EY Finance Consulting Team, you will lead client engagements focused on leveraging finance data intelligence and finance data lake solutions to drive strategic performance improvements. You will manage techno\-functional assessments of finance data processes, lead analysis of data challenges, and design innovative, data\-driven finance solutions. Your role will involve collaborating with senior client stakeholders across industries and geographies to unlock actionable insights from finance data and enable data\-driven decision\-making.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in finance data intelligence, finance data lakes, and finance process optimization. Candidates should have strong knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.), and finance data analytics. Experience in FP\&A, Financial Accounting, and Reporting domains is highly desirable. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead and grow EY’s global finance data intelligence service offering.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting.
* Drive workshops and stakeholder interviews to perform comprehensive current state (As\-Is) finance data process assessments and design optimized future state processes leveraging finance data lakes and advanced analytics.
* Identify and prioritize finance data process improvement opportunities through automation, data integration, technology upgrades, and finance data transformation initiatives.
* Oversee the implementation and development of finance data lakes, data pipelines, and governance frameworks.
* Design and implement KPIs, dashboards, and control frameworks for finance data monitoring and reporting across O2C, P2P, and R2R processes.
* Translate complex business requirements into technical data models and solutions, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
* Lead data profiling, data quality assessments, and validation activities using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools.
* Ensure comprehensive documentation of finance data processes, data models, and project deliverables.
* Collaborate with project managers, cross\-functional teams, and senior client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Apply strong accounting expertise to interpret financial reports and statements in the context of data analytics and governance.
* Provide guidance on financial consolidation, cost allocation, finance planning, and budgeting processes as they relate to data integration.
* Support month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end financial close activities with a focus on data accuracy and reconciliation.
* Possess in\-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects.
* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.
* Collaborative team leader with a focus on driving results and fostering a positive team culture.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance


**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**
* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.
* 5\-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain.
* Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL.


**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**
* Hands\-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.
* Project management certification or experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.


**What We Look For**
* A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning.
* A leader who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world’s top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
* Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Senior Manager - Finance & Accounts (Banking & Treasury)
description:
**About The Company**
 The company is a pioneer in natural ingredient solutions, blending the art of nature with the science of innovation. With a legacy of over five decades, we deliver high\-quality natural extracts, spices, colors, and nutraceuticals across global markets. Our commitment to scientific excellence and sustainability drives our mission to create ingredients that enrich lives naturally.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a seasoned Banking \& Treasury professional with 15\+ years of experience to manage end\-to\-end treasury operations, banking relationships, foreign exchange risk, trade finance, and regulatory compliance.
   

  

 The role requires strategic oversight of working capital, funding, liquidity management, and financial risk mitigation while ensuring adherence to FEMA, RBI, and banking regulations.
   

  

 In addition to managing the treasury and banking functions for the company, the incumbent will also oversee the banking and treasury operations of subsidiaries based in India and Vietnam.
   

  

**Salary Budget CTC:** 
 ₹22\.0 LPA (Including Perks and Incentive)
   

  

**Job Location: Kochi, Kerala, India**
**Key Responsibilities** 
  

  

* Treasury Operations \& Cash Management
+ Monitor inward remittances and ensure timely reconciliation.
+ Oversee working capital limits, including Buyer’s Credit utilization and compliance with sanction terms.
+ Track and analyze weekly collection trends and liquidity positions.
+ Ensure efficient cash flow planning and optimum fund allocation.
+ Drive effective working capital and liquidity management initiatives.

* Trade Finance, Export \& Import Operations
+ Supervise export and import documentation while ensuring regulatory compliance.
+ Monitor timely closure of shipping bills in IDPMS and EDPMS.
+ Facilitate and track Export Packing Credit (EPC) availment and utilization.
+ Coordinate with internal stakeholders and banks for smooth trade finance operations.

* Banking Relationship Management
+ Act as the primary liaison with banks and financial institutions.
+ Manage Letter of Credit (LC) and Bank Guarantee (BG) issuance and administration.
+ Coordinate submission of periodic financial and compliance reports to banks.
+ Strengthen banking relationships to ensure efficient funding and treasury support.

* Foreign Exchange \& Risk Management
+ Monitor and manage forward contracts, utilization, and reporting.
+ Prepare and circulate forex exposure and forward contract reports.
+ Perform Mark\-to\-Market (MTM) valuation and analysis.
+ Track and report unhedged foreign currency exposure.
+ Develop and implement hedging strategies to mitigate forex risks.

* External Commercial Borrowings (ECB)
+ Facilitate ECB loan availing processes including documentation and approvals.
+ Ensure timely filing of ECB returns with regulatory authorities.
+ Monitor compliance with RBI and FEMA regulations related to ECBs.

* Regulatory Compliance \& Risk Governance
+ Ensure compliance with FEMA regulations across all trade and treasury transactions.
+ Manage trade\-related FEMA compliances and reporting requirements.
+ Facilitate and monitor Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) requirements.
+ Ensure adherence to internal controls and governance standards.

* Insurance \& Credit Risk Management
+ Facilitate procurement and monitoring of ECGC policies.
+ Ensure adequate insurance coverage for export receivables.
+ Support credit risk mitigation and monitoring initiatives.

* Credit Rating \& Financial Credibility
+ Coordinate with CARE and other credit rating agencies.
+ Facilitate annual rating reviews and documentation processes.
+ Support initiatives for rating improvement through financial analysis and reporting.

* Supply Chain Financing \& TReDS
+ Manage invoice discounting through TReDS platforms.
+ Negotiate competitive lending rates and optimize financing costs.
+ Ensure timely confirmation and utilization of supply chain financing facilities.


**Key Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong expertise in Treasury Management, Forex, and Trade Finance
* In\-depth knowledge of FEMA, RBI regulations, and ECB guidelines
* Experience in banking negotiations and relationship management
* Proficiency in financial risk management and hedging strategies
* Strong analytical and reporting skills, including MTM and exposure analysis
* Familiarity with TReDS platforms and supply chain financing
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple entities and cross\-functional coordination


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* CA / MBA (Finance) / CMA / ICWA or equivalent qualification preferred
* 15\+ years of relevant experience in Banking, Treasury, or Corporate Finance
* Experience in export\-oriented or manufacturing industries will be an added advantage
